{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom before model catches up",
    "Sentiment momentum amplifies forecast deviations when prices are trending, with high sentiment accelerating divergence from mean-reverting model outputs",
    "Model tends to overshoot current prices during upticks, producing forecasts that are too high relative to near-term outcomes",
    "Underlying price mean reversion is stronger in examples 4-5 where forecasts align better with true outcomes",
    "Sentiment turning points correlate with forecast corrections, especially when historical sentiment becomes mixed or negative",
    "Price level matters - lower price ranges (below 68) show greater forecast accuracy than higher ranges where model loses predictive fidelity"
] }
